clauses.title: CL-D122 records the thin Issue driver
clauses.section: ## CL-D122 — A thin packaged driver runs the Issue review-and-draft round
requires: Each gate's required evidence is the Issue's `issue_spec` and snapshot identities only.
The round drafts a local review file with the Issue status block and publishes nothing.
The driver aggregate alarm resets from 120,000 to 140,000 bytes for the new file.

clauses.title: The Issue driver runs Sol, then Terra, with the Issue's own evidence, and stops for the owner
requires: s.requiredEvidence = [{ source: `github:issue:${number}:spec`, kind: 'github', identity: s.fingerprints.issue_spec }, { source: `snapshot:issue:${number}`, kind: 'snapshot', identity: s.fingerprints.snapshot }];
if (spec !== s.fingerprints.issue_spec) { s.invalidated = 'every gate verdict: the Issue changed'; run.stop('BLOCKED', 'the target moved: issue_spec changed'); }
run.stop('IMPLEMENTATION_READY', 'Sol and Terra returned MERGE on the unchanged issue_spec');

clauses.title: The Issue Skill runs its review-and-draft round through the driver
requires: The review-and-draft round runs through the packaged Issue driver (CL-D122)
The packaged Issue driver derives the Issue `contractInput` and `snapshotFingerprint` (CL-D122).
Resume is a fresh driver run, which is how you revalidate the fingerprints: it recomputes every one from the Issue as it is now (CL-D122).

clauses.title: Each driver-owned Issue Skill passage names its owner
requires: Packaged `build_gate_launch` copies exactly one of these owning-root blocks verbatim into each Issue gate payload (CL-D120):

For every Issue gate, `build_gate_launch` composes the shared Every-gate invariant payload block verbatim, for Sol the Sol-only adversarial block too, the role-authority block and the volatile envelope; Terra never receives the Sol-only block, and the packaged Issue driver calls it (CL-D122).
On the review-and-draft round, the driver makes this check and refuses the target before any run (CL-D122).
The packaged Issue driver computes `issue_spec`, recomputes it before Terra and at readiness, and stops the round at `BLOCKED` when it changes (CL-D122); a fresh run reruns both gates.
The driver reads every result and owns its one relaunch (CL-D122)
The driver drafts the block below whenever its round stops (CL-D122).
